title: Autonomous Ghost Launches No-Code AI Automation Platform for Business.
text:
Autonomous Ghost launches July 17, 2026, offering plain-English AI automation, browser automation, app integrations, desktop bots, agentic workflows, templates, observability, and enterprise-ready security to help teams automate repetitive work and scale operations without code.
Arlington, United States, July 16, 2026 -- ARLINGTON, Texas — July 17, 2026 — AutonomousGhost.com today announced the launch of Autonomous Ghost, a no-code AI automation platform designed to help teams connect apps, automate browser actions, run desktop bots, build AI agents, and execute repeatable workflows using plain-English instructions. Founded by Michael Kaswatuka, Autonomous Ghost was built to make powerful automation accessible to business users, operators, founders, creators, agencies, and enterprise teams that want to reduce manual work without relying on complex coding, brittle scripts, or disconnected automation tools.
Autonomous Ghost enters the market as teams face rising pressure to move faster, reduce operational friction, and do more with leaner resources. Repetitive digital work across sales, customer support, finance, logistics, healthcare, legal, retail, marketing, and back-office operations continues to consume valuable time. Autonomous Ghost addresses that challenge by turning plain-language commands into practical automations that interact with web apps, APIs, browsers, documents, spreadsheets, desktop systems, and AI agents.
Visit For More Info: https://app.autonomousghost.com/use-cases
platform is built around a simple promise: “Describe it. Review it. Run it forever. From prompt to automation in minutes. Automation shouldn’t require a PhD.” Instead of requiring users to manually wire every step of a workflow, Autonomous Ghost helps users describe the outcome they want in plain English, review how the automation will run, and deploy repeatable workflows across apps, browsers, documents, spreadsheets, desktop systems, and AI agents.
Autonomous Ghost combines browser automation, API automation, desktop automation, AI agents, workflow templates, and secure execution tools in one platform. Users can automate tasks such as website scraping, form filling, portal logins, data extraction, CRM updates, email triage, spreadsheet syncing, invoice processing, report generation, approvals, and downstream actions. For teams using both modern SaaS tools and older desktop systems, the platform offers a flexible bridge between browser-based work, connected apps, Windows workflows, and agentic AI execution.
A key differentiator is the platform’s ability to combine app integrations with browser fallback. Autonomous Ghost supports hundreds of integrations and connects tools such as Google Sheets, Gmail, Slack, Stripe, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, CRM platforms, documents, spreadsheets, and business systems. When an API is unavailable or limited, Autonomous Ghost can automate actions directly in the browser, helping teams work across portals and internal systems that traditional integration tools may not reach.
The launch also introduces Ghost Studio for Windows, a command center for building web, desktop, and agent automations, along with Bot Launcher for executing desktop and scheduled bots. Together, these tools allow users to design workflows, record steps, test automations, schedule jobs, monitor execution, and move automations into daily operations faster.
Autonomous Ghost also emphasizes agentic automation through Agent Hub and Build Agents capabilities. Teams can browse prebuilt agents, design custom AI agents, define skills, assign tools, set guardrails, and use approval gates for higher-risk actions. This makes the platform useful for repetitive tasks and multi-step work where AI can help plan, validate, and execute within defined boundaries.
Security, observability, and governance are central to the platform’s value proposition. Autonomous Ghost includes observable runs with logs, screenshots, credit usage, secure credential handling, audit logs, sandbox testing, versioning, rollback, error handling, retries, fallbacks, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints so teams can automate with transparency and control.
“Autonomous Ghost was created to remove the distance between an idea and an automation that actually works,” said Michael Kaswatuka, Founder of Autonomous Ghost. “Our message is simple: describe it, review it, and run it forever. Automation should not require a PhD, a developer team, or months of implementation. Too many businesses know exactly what they want to automate, but they get blocked by tools that are too technical, too fragile, or too narrow. We built Autonomous Ghost so users can explain the work in plain English, connect the apps they already use, automate browser and desktop tasks, add AI agents where they make sense, and run dependable workflows with visibility and control. Whether a team is updating a CRM, processing documents, extracting data, managing emails, or coordinating approvals, our goal is to help them turn repetitive work into reliable automation in minutes—not weeks—so they can focus on growth, customers, and higher-value decisions.”
Key Features
· Plain-English automation: Describe workflows in natural language and turn them into repeatable automations.
· Browser automation: Scrape websites, fill forms, click buttons, log into portals, and extract data from web apps.
· API and app integrations: Connect business tools such as Gmail, Slack, Google Sheets, Stripe, HubSpot, Salesforce, Shopify, and CRM systems.
· Desktop automation: Use Ghost Studio and Bot Launcher to automate Windows, legacy apps, Java, Citrix, RDP, and scheduled desktop workflows.
· AI agents and Agent Hub: Build or browse agents with skills, tools, memory, guardrails, and approval gates.
· Templates and quickstart workflows: Launch proven automations faster with ready-to-run templates and guided setup.
· Observability and governance: Monitor runs with logs, screenshots, usage tracking, versioning, rollback, error handling, and audit-ready controls.
Autonomous Ghost launches publicly on July 17, 2026. With its combination of no-code automation, AI agents, app integrations, browser automation, desktop bots, templates, observability, and security-minded controls, the platform is positioned to help teams automate routine work, reduce operational drag, improve accuracy, and scale output without adding unnecessary headcount or complexity.
About Autonomous Ghost
Autonomous Ghost is a no-code AI automation platform that helps teams connect apps, automate browser and desktop tasks, build AI agents, and run business workflows using plain-English instructions. Built for modern teams that want to eliminate repetitive work and scale operations, Autonomous Ghost brings app integrations, browser automation, desktop automation, workflow templates, AI agents, secure execution, observability, and performance tracking into one automation stack.
To learn more, explore features, or start automating with Autonomous Ghost, visit https://autonomousghost.com .
